I’ve been a patient at Sydenham House Medical Centre for some time, and unfortunately, the experience has been consistently disappointing. While the doctors are okay at best, the real issue is the lack of access and capacity.

If you don’t call exactly at 8:00 AM, you’re likely to be 50+ people deep in the queue, and even then there’s no guarantee of getting an appointment. On several occasions, it’s been quicker for me to go to A&E or see the hospital GP than to reach my own surgery.

The reception staff are lovely and do their best, but the system they’re working in is clearly overstretched. This surgery is simply not fit for purpose.

A quick look at their Google reviews says it all: 1.6 stars out of 5 from over 200 reviews, with the majority being one-star. That level of consistent negative feedback reflects serious issues that need to be addressed.

If there were better options within my catchment area, I would have switched long ago.
